race.comment: HOLLYWOOD FRANKY (8) jumped from this box last time and also the same course and distance to score a Special conditions Veteran race win (19.62). In form and can measure up again. STILSON (2) doesn't have the best strike-rate. Finished in the money last time though when third (19.69) at this track. Form here sound including two wins. The form out of last race has been strong. Can feature again. HEAD HUNTER (1) was in the minors two back (19.91) at this track but ran below best last time there, finishing 6th. Has a good record here at this journey. Has a solid record from this box including four wins and a minor placing. Can figure in the finish. AUSSIE SUPREME (4) was out of the money here last time out but can bounce back.
